rooms.name: The tunnel
rooms.desc:
Suddenly you feel that the tunnel leads slightly down.. The only 
exit is to the west, and it leads down..

rooms.name: The long tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a long east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel is quite
wide at this point.

rooms.name: The long tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a long east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel becomes
narrow to the west.

rooms.name: The long tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a long east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel is quite
narrow at this point. You notice a small hole leading south.

rooms.name: The long tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a long east-west leading tunnel. The tunnel starts sloping
down towards the west.

rooms.name: The golden cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the south and west.

extras.desc: It looks good, but as you look closely you notice that it has no value.

rooms.name: The golden cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the south and east, to the north is a narrow
tunnel.

extras.desc: It looks good, but as you look closely you realize that it has no value.

rooms.name: The passage
rooms.desc:
You are in a small passage, it leads south, to the west is a golden
cave.

rooms.name: The golden cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the north and west, east from you there is
a small passage.

extras.desc: It looks good, but as you look closely you notice that it has no value.

rooms.name: The golden cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the south, east and north.

extras.desc: It looks good, but as you look closely you notice that it has no value.

rooms.name: The hole
rooms.desc:
You are standing by a large hole in the floor, when you looks down
into the darkness you feel frightened.

rooms.name: The tunnel
rooms.desc: You are in a small tunnel, it leads from east to the west.

rooms.name: The tunnel
rooms.desc: You are in a larger tunnel, it leads from west to east.

rooms.name: The passage
rooms.desc:
You are in a passage that leads towards the south. To the east 
you see a tunnel.

rooms.name: The golden cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a giant cave, all the walls are shining with a soft golden
light. The cave continues to the north, to the west you see a dark 
passage.

extras.desc: It looks good, but as you look closely you notice that it has no value.

rooms.name: The dark passage.
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark passage, that leads east. In the ceiling you notice
a small hole, just big enough to pass through.

rooms.name: The passage
rooms.desc:
You are in a passage that leads north-south. You notice a small
light to the south.

extras.desc: Well you can't see where it comes from..

rooms.name: The secret tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a secret tunnel that leads north, to the south you see
a small chamber.

rooms.name: The cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a light cave, from torches several feet above your
head fire lights the room. The cave continues to the west and south.
To the north a small hole leads to a tunnel.

rooms.name: The cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a light cave, from torches several feet above your
head fire lights the room. The cave continues to the east and south.

rooms.name: The passage
rooms.desc:
You are in a north-south leading passage. To the south you see
light.

extras.desc: It nearly is enough to light the passage.

rooms.name: The secret tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a secret tunnel that leads west, you feel evilness
approaching you as you continue west.

rooms.name: The secret chamber
rooms.desc:
You are in a secret chamber, the room is filled with an evil
feeling.

rooms.name: The cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a light cave, from torches several feet above your
head fire lights the room. The cave continues to the north and west.

rooms.name: The cave
rooms.desc:
You are in a light cave, from torches several feet above your
head fire lights the room. The cave continues to the east and north.
To the west a passage leads north.

rooms.name: The passage
rooms.desc:
You are in a passage, to the east you see a cave. Light from the
cave lights up the passage. To the north the passage leads into
the darkness..

32.name: the Thief Guildmaster
32.long: Delfin the Rogue Guildmaster is standing here.
32.desc:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief. She is dressed in poor clothing, having
the appearance of a beggar.

4100.name: the Mage
4100.long:
A small intelligent looking mage is standing here. It looks like he
knows his way with the magic.
4100.desc: His IQ makes almost any dikumud player look stupid..

4101.name: the troll
4101.long: A large mean-looking troll is here.

4102.name: the snake
4102.long: A large green snake, looks like a guardian for an evil force.

4103.name: the Thief
4103.long: A thief, all dressed in black.

4105.name: a centipede
4105.long: A small harmless centipede is here.
4105.desc: It doesn't seem to pay any attention to you.

4106.name: the Warrior
4106.long: A human warrior is here. He has a evil grin in his face.
4106.desc: He doesn't look friendly at all...

4112.name: the bugbear
4112.desc: It looks like a walking carpet.

4113.name: the ogre
4113.long: An ogre stands here, grinning broadly.
4113.desc: It looks rather pleased with itself.

64.name: A huge rock
64.long: A huge rock is lying on the ground here

3055.name: a white potion
3055.long: A small white potion rests here.

extras.desc: The potion has a small label which reads 'Cure the Sick'.

3057.name: a silver potion
3057.long: A small silver vial rests here.

extras.desc: The potion has a red cross on the side.

4100.name: a glittering blade
4100.long: A glittering blade is here, you sense the forces of evil

extras.desc: You'll become as evil as the weapon, if you use it!

4101.name: a swordsmans gloves
4101.long:
Some gloves is here. They look like the right kind of
equipment to use when fighting.

extras.desc: Looks very useful in combat.  They are made of fine chain mail.

4102.name: a scroll which reads "ysafg"
4102.long: A scroll which reads "ysafg", it looks very fragile and quite old.

4103.name: a green slime mold
4103.long: A green slime mold is here. Stinks like sh**.

extras.desc: It wasn't meant to be food, - Certainly not for humans.

4104.name: a green slime mold
4104.long: A green slime mold is here. Stinks real bad.

extras.desc: It wasn't mend to be food, - Certainly not for humans.

6108.name: a big pile of gold coins
6108.long: A big pile of gold coins is lying here.
